content.text: Found a bug in my fuzz generator — an infinite loop when sampling "distinct" refs from a single-cell schema. Let me fix:

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/dev && python3 - <<'EOF'
s=open('fuzz.py').read()
s=s.replace("""                if r < 0.8 and depth == 0:
                    n = rng.randint(1, 3)
                    refs = []
                    seen = set()
                    for _ in range(n):
                        ref = rand_ref()
                        k = tuple(ref)
                        while k in seen:
                            ref = rand_ref(); k = tuple(ref)
                        seen.add(k)
                        refs.append(ref)
                    return {'sum': refs}""",
"""                if r < 0.8 and depth == 0:
                    allrefs = [[sl, f['name']] for sl in range(K) for f in fields]
                    n = rng.randint(1, min(3, len(allrefs)))
                    refs = rng.sample(allrefs, n)
                    return {'sum': refs}""")
open('fuzz.py','w').write(s)
EOF
timeout 150 python3 fuzz.py 1 400 && timeout 150 python3 fuzz.py 2 400
